summary: mirror users.tier into Clerk publicMetadata from Stripe webhook for SSR-friendly tier reads
description:
Postgres users.tier is the source of truth (Stripe webhook writes it; /api/quota reads it). Client UI now reads via /api/quota (todo:c19a7b6b). That works but adds a round trip on every page that wants to render tier.

Mirror the value into Clerk's user.publicMetadata.tier from the webhook handlers so server-rendered components (and any future Clerk-session-token-driven UI) can read tier directly without an extra fetch. Postgres remains canonical; Clerk metadata is a cache.

Plan:
  - import { clerkClient } from '@clerk/nextjs/server' (or whichever the current SDK exposes)
  - In handleCheckoutCompleted, handleSubscriptionDeleted, handleSubscriptionUpdated: after the Postgres UPDATE, call clerkClient.users.updateUserMetadata(userId, { publicMetadata: { tier } })
  - Tolerant: if Clerk update throws, log and continue — Postgres is still canonical
  - Tests update mockClerkClient and assert updateUserMetadata is called with the right args
  - Document the cache semantics in the webhook file header
